description: Na₂ScCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.68 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.18 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.32 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-57°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom.
